sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Sweets Merge is a match-three puzzle game where players combine identical candies and desserts to create even tastier treats. The game starts with simple sweets and progresses to more complex desserts as players level up. To play, players click and drag a sweet to move it on the board and release it over another identical sweet to merge them into a higher-level dessert.

The game's mechanics are easy to learn, but as players progress, the board fills up, and the gameplay becomes more challenging. Players must think strategically about which sweets to merge and when to create the most powerful desserts. The game's objective is to clear the board by merging sweets and reaching the target score before the board fills up.

As players progress, new sweets and desserts are introduced, including cakes, chocolates, donuts, and more. Each sweet has its own unique points value, and players must strategically combine them to maximize their points. The game's core mechanics are simple, yet addictive and challenging, making it a must-play for puzzle game enthusiasts.

sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks
sections.body:
For new players, Sweets Merge can be a challenging game, especially in the early levels. Here are some beginner tips and tricks to help you get started:

First, focus on creating combinations of three sweets to clear the board. This will give you the most points and help you progress to the next level.

Second, try to create combinations of high-point sweets, such as cakes and chocolates. These sweets are worth more points and will help you progress faster.

Third, use power-ups strategically to clear the board and reach the target score. Power-ups can be used to clear specific sweets, create combinations, or even clear the entire board.

Finally, take your time and think strategically about which sweets to merge and when. This will help you progress faster and earn more points.
